answer: Each identity locks 22 POA for 16 epochs and publishes an onyx commitment to its funding and device links. A whisper beacon chooses 7 established auditors; 5 replay signed work receipts. For the kth identity in one linked cluster, collateral is 22*k^2 POA, so each new fake adds 22*(2*k-1) POA. The hollow registry records proofs; failed replay slashes every linked bond and blocks the cluster for 11 epochs.
